package repository

import (
	"context"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"time"
)

type HybridConsequences interface {
	ClaimHybridConsequenceEvaluation(context.Context, time.Time, time.Duration) (domain.HybridConsequenceEvaluation, bool, error)
	CheckpointHybridConsequenceInputs(context.Context, domain.HybridConsequenceEvaluation, domain.PolicyBundle, domain.HybridPrerequisiteGraph) (domain.HybridConsequenceEvaluation, error)
	CompleteHybridConsequenceEvaluation(context.Context, domain.HybridConsequenceEvaluation, domain.HybridConsequence) (domain.HybridConsequenceReceipt, error)
	ReleaseHybridConsequenceEvaluation(context.Context, domain.HybridConsequenceEvaluation, time.Time) error
	GetHybridConsequence(context.Context, string) (domain.HybridConsequenceReceipt, error)
}
